summary: Axogen filed an 8-K/A supplementing its 2026-09-10 report on a merger with BioCircuit, filing the Agreement and Plan of Merger as Exhibit 2.1 and a corrected investor presentation. No price per share, premium, stake, or expected close was disclosed in this amendment, nor any board recommendation or advisor. The amendment is procedural, qualifying prior disclosures and furnishing Regulation FD materials. The underlying merger makes Axogen the target; terms must be read from the Exhibit 2.1 merger agreement. Watch for definitive deal terms, regulatory clock, and any proxy timeline.
